comment_text: ‎I love how this product monitors sleep patterns without the need for any wearable device.
Some nice touches to such a lamp. The only real issue i have with this kind of device is privacy, who else is getting this data?
I wonder how well this works if two people are moving around in the same bed.
Does the app show detailed sleep position changes throughout the night?
The snoring detection feature honestly shocked me the most.
